name: explain-mode
description: Step through code like a debugger; a local LLM explains each statement.

commands.title: Explain Mode: Set API key (OpenAI-compatible provider)

enumDescriptions: Default. llama.cpp inside the extension with Qwen2.5-Coder 3B (2.1 GB, downloaded once into the extension storage). Nothing to install, ~0.7 s per step.
Ollama, local, when you want another model size (explain.ollamaUrl / explain.model).
Any OpenAI-compatible API: OpenRouter, OpenAI, LM Studio, vLLM (explain.openai.*; key via 'Explain Mode: Set API key')
Models registered in VS Code, e.g. GitHub Copilot (explain.vscodeLm.*). Not available in Cursor.
Claude Code CLI, reusing your Claude login (subscription or key). A persistent session keeps it at ~4 s per call (explain.claude.*).
Cursor Agent CLI (`agent -p`), reusing your Cursor subscription; run `agent login` once (explain.cursor.*).

explain.language.description: Language of the explanations (e.g. French). Labels stay in English.

explain.context.fullFunctionMaxLines.description: Functions up to this many lines are sent whole; longer ones get a window around the statement.

explain.context.before.description: Lines before the current statement in the window (long functions only).

explain.context.after.description: Lines after the current statement in the window (long functions only).

explain.context.definitionDepth.description: Go-to-definition levels resolved below the current statement; each level's functions are summarized and fed to the level above.

explain.auto.enabled.description: Make Continue (F5) auto-walk instead of running silently to the next breakpoint. Off by default: F5 runs to the next breakpoint, the ▶▶ toolbar button (Cmd+Alt+A) starts the auto-walk.

explain.auto.dwellMs.description: Time to stay on each statement in auto mode, after its explanation is shown.

explain.askBranch.description: On Step Over at an `if`, ask which branch to follow; the other one is skipped.

explain.openai.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API (…/v1).

explain.openai.model.description: Model id for the OpenAI-compatible provider.

explain.vscodeLm.vendor.description: Vendor filter for vscode.lm (e.g. copilot). Empty = any.

explain.vscodeLm.family.description: Model family filter for vscode.lm (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-3.5-sonnet). Empty = first available.

explain.claude.model.description: Model for the Claude CLI (--model), e.g. haiku, sonnet. Empty = CLI default.

explain.claude.bin.description: Path to the claude executable if not on PATH.

explain.claude.persistentSession.description: Keep one claude process alive and send each call as a turn (~4 s) instead of starting a process per call (~10 s). Recycled every 30 turns.

explain.cursor.model.description: Model for the Cursor Agent CLI (--model). Empty = account default.

explain.cursor.bin.description: Path to the Cursor `agent` executable if not on PATH.

explain.exampleValues.description: Ask the model for example values of declared variables (one extra call per statement). Turn off on slow providers.

explain.prefetch.description: Statements prepared ahead of the current one, along the Step Over path. Raise it (6–8) on slow providers.

explain.claude.sessions.description: Persistent claude processes kept in parallel; more = more prefetch throughput, more memory.

explain.claude.effort.description: --effort passed to the Claude CLI. 'low' is 3x faster on long answers (measured: 300 words in 16 s vs 50 s) with no visible loss on explanations. Empty = CLI default.

explain.claude.extraArgs.description: Extra flags for the claude CLI, e.g. ["--max-budget-usd", "1"].

explain.cursor.extraArgs.description: Extra flags for the Cursor agent CLI, e.g. ["--mode", "ask"].

enumDescriptions: Use the Claude Code login only (Pro/Max usage). API-key variables are hidden from the claude process so it can never bill per token.
Let the claude process see your environment as is (an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY there would be used and billed).
One call per function on seconds-per-call providers (CLI ones), one call per statement on fast local models.
Always one call per function (long answers: fine for big models, risky for a 3B).
explain.batchPerFunction.description: Explain a whole function in a single model call and cache every statement from it.

explain.embedded.model.description: Advanced: GGUF for the embedded provider, as hf:<owner>/<repo>/<file.gguf>. The default is the measured sweet spot; for other sizes use Ollama.

scripts.test:dap:throw: npm run test:dap >/dev/null && EXPLAIN_SCENARIO=throw node test/dap.js test/fixtures/throwflow.ts 3 && EXPLAIN_SCENARIO=next node test/dap.js test/fixtures/throwflow.ts 13 && EXPLAIN_SCENARIO=next node test/dap.js test/fixtures/throwflow.ts 10
